findings.problem: Comprehensible and correctly masculine for a turn-closing marker (precedent ui.chat.action.stopped 'Arrêté'), but participe + 'sur une erreur' reads slightly stiff as a status line; 'arrêté en erreur' is the commoner fr dev phrasing (cf. ui.chat.pickers.info_model.stopped_ago_reason 'arrêtée il y a {stoppedage}… raison : {stopreason}').

Fit, not meaning. en 'Mark all {count} read' is 16 cells at a two-digit count; fr is 26 (+10, +63%). The label is shrink-0 beside a flex-1 min-w-0 truncate section heading, and its sr-only fallback is a fixed pixel breakpoint derived from the ENGLISH label: src/renderer/src/features/chat/components/chat-sidebar.tsx:438 MARK_ALL_READ_LABEL_SHED = "@max-[253px]/chatheading:sr-only", justified at :405-423 as '253px is the TWO-DIGIT break … the action is unshrinkable so the name absorbs whatever is left', with the stated invariant 'Above the break the full label fits and nothing truncates'. That invariant is en-specific: with fr the row width at which the heading stops being ellipsised rises to roughly 315-325px, the shed still fires only below 253px, and the default panel is 280px (263px row), so in that whole band the section heading ellipsises while the action stays fully spelled — the trade design D1 rejected at 267-269px for en. Secondary: the count sits in trailing parentheses, so if truncation ever does occur the number the label exists to name (sidecar: 'The number is the exact count the request will clear') is the first thing lost, and a bare '(12)' beside a section heading can also read as a badge rather than the action's object.
findings.suggested: Keep the wording — it is faithful and matches the shipped precedent ui.notifications.action.mark_all_read 'Tout marquer comme lu' — and fix the layout: re-measure the fr string and raise the shed breakpoint for fr (≈310px row) or drive it from a per-locale measurement. Shortest faithful copy form if a smaller footprint is preferred: 'Marquer les {count} comme lus' (24 cells at two digits), which diverges from the shipped precedent, so the layout fix is preferred.
